title: Oracle on the hook to pay data centre investors even if site has no electricity
summary: This Financial Times article reports on Oracle's contractual obligation to pay data center investors regardless of whether the facility has electricity supply, highlighting unusual risk allocation in data center financing deals.
problem_solved: Reports on a financial/legal dispute regarding contractual obligations in data center infrastructure investments.
why_valuable: Reveals risky contractual structures in data center financing that could have implications for investors and the broader infrastructure investment market.
